title: Aether Revolt Promos: card flavor text

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: An inventor of Ghirapur who speaks against the Consulate's seizure of inventions and champions lasting change.

entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: The ruling authority of Ghirapur whose control the renegades seek liberation from.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: The city whose people, inventors and illegal salvage trade are referred to in the flavor text.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: The plane whose soul is aether and which Tezzeret came to give his full attention.

entities.name: Kadhu
entities.description: A skywhaler who uses a harpoon high in the skies.

entities.name: Baral
entities.description: The Chief of Compliance, who mocks quenched flames.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: A planeswalker who claims that with eight walkers he can deliver the city.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker who came to Kaladesh, finished the Planar Bridge, and prized the Paradox Engine.

entities.name: Freejam
entities.description: A zone of fierce independence where dragons perch in the towers.

entities.name: Kari Zev
entities.description: A skyship raider who follows no one's rules but her own aboard her ship.

entities.name: Dragon's Smile
entities.description: Kari Zev's ship.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker who vows to be wherever the strong would harm the weak.

entities.name: Great Conduit
entities.description: The flow of aether on Kaladesh, likened to a river that cannot be controlled.

entities.name: Aether
entities.description: The energy described as the soul of Kaladesh, found in pure nodules prized by miners and gremlins.

entities.name: Gonti
entities.description: A crime lord sustained by magic, often described as heartless.

entities.name: Gonti's Aether Heart
entities.description: The magic that sustains Gonti's life.

entities.name: Renegades
entities.description: The rebels who mounted an aether disruptor on a thopter to destroy Tezzeret's Planar Bridge.

entities.name: Planar Bridge
entities.description: Tezzeret's creation, which the renegades sought to destroy.

entities.name: Oviya Pashiri
entities.description: A sage lifecrafter.

entities.name: Bes Tavani
entities.description: A Bomat merchant who boasts of moving whatever can be built.

entities.name: Paradox Engine
entities.description: A glorious item that convinced Tezzeret that Kaladesh deserved his attention.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: A planeswalker who says the Peacewalker's sole purpose is fear.

entities.name: Gremlins
entities.description: Wild creatures that feed on nodules of pure aether.

events.summary: The Consulate crackdown silences the workshops and seizes inventors' creations.
events.quote: "The workshops are silent. Our creations have been seized. They have killed what made us alive." —Pia Nalaar

events.summary: Tezzeret declares the Planar Bridge finished.
events.quote: "It is finished. Now the real work can begin." —Tezzeret

events.summary: The renegades mount an aether disruptor aboard a thopter to destroy Tezzeret's Planar Bridge.
events.quote: The renegades mounted an aether disruptor aboard a lightweight thopter to destroy Tezzeret's Planar Bridge.

relations.note: Pia condemns the Consulate's seizure of creations.
